div.div:
Canonical Model Pathologies:
• Organizational Gridlock: Any field change triggers multi-team review loops.
• Lowest Common Denominator: Model loses semantic richness.
• Distributed Monolith: Upstream releases break downstream compile-time types.

div.div:
Bounded Context Advantages:
• Autonomous Evolution: Each service changes its internal model independently.
• Semantic Precision: Billing models money; Shipping models dimensions; no compromise.
• Zero Blast Radius: Upstream contract changes are absorbed inside the ACL translation boundary.
